name: EXAM 申请医生姓名与 STAFF_DICT 不一致率

sides.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS NONNULL, SUM(CASE WHEN sd.NAME IS NULL OR TRIM(e.DOCTOR_NAME) <> TRIM(sd.NAME) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS MISMATCH FROM EXAM.EXAM_MASTER e LEFT JOIN COMM.STAFF_DICT sd ON e.DOCTOR_USER = sd.EMP_NO WHERE e.REQ_DATE_TIME >= TO_DATE(:START_DATE,'YYYY-MM-DD') AND e.REQ_DATE_TIME < TO_DATE(:END_DATE,'YYYY-MM-DD') AND e.DOCTOR_USER IS NOT NULL

object_desc_tpl: EXAM.EXAM_MASTER.DOCTOR_NAME 与 COMM.STAFF_DICT 不一致率
